active_task.implementation_shape: Reuse captured AST/import/argument/source summaries for a shared value-and-callable transfer worklist. No per-backend exception list or additional proof pipeline.
active_task.scope_rule: Declare exact changed files and their base hashes before editing; preserve unrelated WIP. Added scope or unsupported transfer returns to review before expansion.

work_budget.budget_exhaustion: UNKNOWN and original active alert retained

active_task.completion_rule: All38 fixed cases must be accounted for by inspected source-bound role evidence or retained unresolved/credential evidence; unresolved cases are not called repaired. No forced partition to satisfy a target.

required_paired_examples_before_edit.safe: Source-bound getter value reaches the canonical URL slot.
required_paired_examples_before_edit.unsafe: The same value also reaches auth/password/Authorization or an opaque consumer; keep it active.

required_paired_examples_before_edit.safe: Tuple-held bound getter is invoked and its result is discarded.
required_paired_examples_before_edit.unsafe: The callable or returned value escapes, is rebound, or is supplied to authentication; keep it active or UNKNOWN.

required_paired_examples_before_edit.safe: Exact source-owned helper preserves URL argument role.
required_paired_examples_before_edit.unsafe: Helper swaps URL/auth slots, loses source identity, or has unsupported forwarding; keep it active.

required_paired_examples_before_edit.safe: Captured independent receiver is proven disjoint from the selected declaration.
required_paired_examples_before_edit.unsafe: Unknown receiver, alias, reflective access or candidate-related mutation is never assumed disjoint.

required_paired_examples_before_edit.safe: Hash-current complete capture and matching cold/warm decisions.
required_paired_examples_before_edit.unsafe: Source/config/helper drift, malformed witness or exhausted budget restores the original active alert.

verification_and_commit_order: Freeze exact candidate, source roots, selected IDs, labels, execution profile and budgets before measurement.
Run focused positive/negative and source-mutation/cache controls. Keep old assertions; separate justified expectation changes.
Independent reviewer inspects exact candidate and unsafe counterparts; rejected evidence is retained.
Replay the same fixed family, application census and13 historical TP controls; inspect every removal and newly emitted alert.
Record active/partitioned/unclear counts, retained TP/severity, complete coverage and scan seconds; run existing workflow evidence gate.
Commit only reviewed scoped files with measured counts; push and verify remote head. Full goal/merge/release claims require all broader gates.
retry_rule: Retain failed attempts. Two consecutive candidates without new bound evidence or a Pareto improvement trigger root-cause reassessment using the existing no-gain workflow; they do not pause the user goal or authorize deleting unrelated work.
reuse_rule: Reuse only exact source/tool/config/profile-bound proofs. A source or method-code mutation invalidates the reused proof; unknown relevance runs again.

metric_rule.publication_gate: Freeze before prediction; at least30 independently adjudicated final alerts and80% conservative actionable precision with a confidence interval; include unresolved/unclear final alerts in the denominator. Report primitive truth and bounded TP retention separately.
metric_rule.reviewer_provenance: Disclose actual AI/human labels and pending second review. Never call existing exposed tuning data fresh heldout.
